name: selvage-client
description: Live collaborative editing over the Selvage session protocol

commands.title: Join a session from an invite link
Open a document from the room
Set the name other participants see

selvage.serverUrl.description: The server to host on, as a WebSocket address — the one a selvaged prints, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:8080. Asked for when unset.

selvage.displayName.description: The name other participants see. A change while a session is live renames this connection at once; the change also applies to the next host or join. At most 32 UTF-16 code units; an emoji costs two. A longer name is refused rather than shortened. Asked for when unset; the Selvage: Set the name other participants see command changes it.

selvage.autoSave.description: Save a document the room changed, once the room has settled on it. The host's working copy is the room's truth, so a remote edit that is not written leaves the file on disk stale. A guest's document is virtual and its save writes nothing; the call is what clears the editor's unsaved marker.

enumDescriptions: Draw no name over the document. A peer is shown by their coloured caret bar, their selection fill, a tick in the overview ruler and the name in the caret's hover, and the status bar lists the room.
A small name box above the peer's caret, out of the line's flow. It covers the line above the caret and leans on undocumented editor behaviour, so it is cosmetic and not guaranteed.
The peer's name inside the line, behind a coloured border, built from documented decoration fields only. It covers the text it sits against.
selvage.cursorLabel.description: How a remote peer's name is drawn at their cursor. The default draws no name over the document; "floating" and "chip" opt into one and each covers some of the text. The full name is always in the caret's hover and the status bar. Applies to an open session at once.
